title: Make first installation predictable
acceptance: Empty-root download, interruption/retry, low-disk handling and a useful failure message pass isolated tests. Recruit voluntary reports across three RAM/GPU classes. External reports stay separate from verified lab results.
remaining: Voluntary reports across additional consumer RAM/GPU classes remain unverified until reproduced.

title: Keep chat and coding work recoverable
acceptance: Cancel, delete-during-generation, scroll while streaming, queue release, model switching and resume pass synthetic regressions. No data-loss release ships.

title: Explain model memory and coding compatibility
acceptance: Conservative memory guidance, disk preflight, actionable load errors, and capability results bound to exact model/runtime hashes. No universal model-support claim.

title: Offer a small, reviewable support report
acceptance: Opt-in report shows version, model identifier, RAM/GPU class and sanitized error category. Preview before export; never include chats, project files, private paths, credentials or environment values. Synthetic redaction tests pass.

title: Prepare a trustworthy update path
acceptance: Explicit update choice, hash verification, interruption recovery and rollback are tested in an isolated copy. Preserve user data. Code signing remains funding-dependent; no paid enrollment without approval.

title: Publish what the month actually taught us
acceptance: Report observed download deltas, voluntary install outcomes, fixes and remaining limits. Choose the next release from repeated user problems. Financial totals require owner-supplied gross/fees/net/spend; never infer them from a goal.

title: Finish replies when a local server keeps its stream open
acceptance: Terminal stream marker releases generation and the connection; the next prompt works. Preserve pre-terminal text, finish reason and usage, fragmented markers, EOF fallback, cancellation and error cleanup. Qualify the exact packaged candidate before marking delivered.
validation: Six focused stream checks plus the 145-check regression suite and exact public-package fresh-install qualification passed.

title: Organize completed chats and polish navigation
acceptance: Move, create project from chat, undo, rename, keyboard navigation and restart persistence verified with synthetic data.
